chapters.title: A Claim Is Not Evidence
chapters.blurb: 228 tasks, one queue, and the one rule the whole system serves: an implementer being satisfied is a claim; a recording is evidence.

chapters.title: The Worker Records the Run
chapters.blurb: Gates in ascending cost, free self-validation that evaporates, and the final happy run frozen into the task's evidence folder.

chapters.title: The Critic Attacks the Tape
chapters.blurb: A fresh session attacks the tape: predict then verify, hold the diff against the recording, cite every finding to a point.

chapters.title: Refuted Means Start Over
chapters.blurb: A refutation sends the work back to the top with the critic's report as context — and every verified lap makes the gates stricter.

chapters.title: Why the Critic Beats a Reviewer
chapters.blurb: A reviewer grades the story of a change; the critic re-runs it with its own seeds and tries to break it. Only one catches what nobody wrote down.
